ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Access Tool - AnyDesk Piped Password Via CLI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects piping the password to an anydesk instance via CMD and the '--set-password' flag.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/c\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*echo\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ \\-\\-set\\-password.*"))
